d.d: A surface created by projecting a closed two-dimensional curve along an axis intersecting the plane of the curve.
A solid figure bounded by a cylinder and two parallel planes intersecting the cylinder.
Any object in the form of a circular cylinder.
To calender; to press (paper, etc.) between rollers to make it glossy.
third-person singular simple present indicative of cylinder
Describing a map projection in which meridians are mapped onto vertical lines and parallels of latitude onto horizontal lines.
